anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Not of bloods or of a man's will.
Quoted: I will declare your name to my brothers.

pass_a_gloss: For the adoption in Christ became for us authority of so great a salvation, we who have come to be not from bloods and will of man and woman, whom he also confesses to be his brothers saying: I will announce your name to my brothers.
pass_b_english: For the adoption in Christ has become for us authority of so great a salvation — we who have come to be not of bloods and of the will of man and woman, whom he also confesses to be his brothers, saying: "I will declare your name to my brothers." (John 1:12–13) (Hebrews 2:12) (Psalm 22:22) (Romans 8:15) (Galatians 4:5)
source_text: Ἡ γὰρ ἐν <Χ(ριστ)ῷ> υ[ἱ]οθεσία ἐξουσία τοσαύτης ἡ[μ]ῖν ἐγένετο σωτηρίας τοῖς ο[ὐχὶ] ἐξ αἱμάτων καὶ θελήσεω[ς ἀ]νδρὸς καὶ γυναικὸς γεν[ομέ]νοις, οὓς καὶ ὁμο[λ]ογεῖ ἀ[δελ]φοὺς αὐτοῦ εἶναι λέ[γων·] "Ἀπαγγελῶ τὸ ὄνομά σου τ[οῖ]ς ἀδελφοῖς μου".
